{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the unique sites
print("Unique sites:", df['site'].unique())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Number of unique patient_ids:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total rows:", len(df))
print("Number of duplicate patient_ids:", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for the sentinel value in biomarker_baseline
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check assay_batch
print("Unique assay_batch values:", df['assay_batch'].unique())

# Check sample_seq distribution
df_sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print("Number of patients with multiple sample_seq:", (df_sample_seq_max > 1).sum())"}
